summary: A Yes vote authorizes general obligation bonds for School Facilities Improvement District No. 1 within the Yosemite Unified School District, repaid by property taxes in that improvement district.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports issuing the School Facilities Improvement District No. 1 bond to fund school facilities.
tax.quote: Measure W-Yosemite Unified School District, School Facilities Improvement District (SFID) No.1 Bond

schools.text: A Yes vote supports a bond for facilities in Yosemite Unified School District’s School Facilities Improvement District No. 1.
schools.quote: Measure W-Yosemite Unified School District, School Facilities Improvement District (SFID) No.1 Bond

tax.text: A No vote rejects issuing the School Facilities Improvement District No. 1 bond under this measure.
tax.quote: Measure W-Yosemite Unified School District, School Facilities Improvement District (SFID) No.1 Bond

schools.text: A No vote rejects the bond for facilities in Yosemite Unified School District’s School Facilities Improvement District No. 1.
schools.quote: Measure W-Yosemite Unified School District, School Facilities Improvement District (SFID) No.1 Bond
